title: Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL
abstract: arXiv:2609.37898v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents typically relies on sparse outcome-based rewards. This leads to a severe cold-start problem, as early-stage policies often fail to solve sampled tasks, leaving little useful reward signal for learning. To mitigate this problem, we use on-policy distillation (OPD) to provide token-level guidance on the student's own rollouts. We find that the benefit of this guidance depends on the performance gap between the teacher and the student. When the teacher substantially outperforms the student, distillation helps guide the student through the early training stage where outcome rewards provide little learning signal. As the gap narrows and eventually reverses, however, continued distillation becomes less beneficial and may hinder further improvement. translated_title: 先引导，后放手：面向稀疏奖励智能体强化学习的差距自适应教师调度
translated_abstract: 长程智能体的强化学习通常依赖于稀疏的、基于最终结果的任务奖励。这会导致严重的冷启动问题：早期策略往往无法解决采样到的任务，几乎无法为学习提供有用的奖励信号。为缓解这一问题，我们采用在线策略蒸馏（OPD），在学生模型自身生成的轨迹上提供token级别的指导。我们发现，这种指导的收益取决于教师与学生之间的性能差距：当教师显著优于学生时，蒸馏有助于在结果奖励几乎不提供学习信号的早期训练阶段引导学生；然而随着差距缩小乃至最终逆转，持续的蒸馏收益递减，甚至可能阻碍学生的进一步提升。受此观察启发，我们提出了差距自适应教师调度，它在学生的强化学习目标中引入一个OPD项，其权重……
tldr: 提出差距自适应教师调度（GATS），根据师生之间的性能差距动态调节在线策略蒸馏的强度——在训练早期加强教师引导以解决稀疏奖励下的冷启动问题，并在学生能力接近或超过教师后逐步“放手”，避免蒸馏阻碍进一步提升。
en_tdlr: Proposes Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling (GATS), which dynamically adjusts the strength of on-policy distillation based on the teacher-student performance gap—providing stronger guidance early in training to overcome the cold-start problem of sparse-reward agentic RL, and gradually letting go once the student approaches or surpasses the teacher.
